summary:
Persisted AST code edges as code_node↔code_node graph edges (deterministic, no judge). Committed 2d4d10ad on orch/attempt/7324f0fd-3872-4c3a-a82b-e7b554aea59d-1 (10 files, +960/-15).

EDGE MODEL: edges live in a SEPARATE overlay.code_edges array (never the task `edges` array → stay out of DAG/judge/traversal). Shape: {from_file, to(code:<file>#<name>)|to_file, kind:'calls'|'imports', name?, ambiguous?}. New lib/code-extract/resolve-edges.js (pure resolveCodeEdges): call edge (from=file,to=callee-name) → ALL repo code_nodes defining that name (ambiguous:true if >1; no local def → dropped/external); local import → imported file's EXPORTED symbols, else a file-level fallback edge; external imports dropped. `from` stays the file (extractor attributes calls file-granularly). Deterministic sort+dedup.

STORAGE: overlay.js add/replace/removeCodeEdgesForFile + emitDiff code_edge_added/removed (prev-state diff) keyed on synthetic codeedge:<from_file> node; graph-store replays into loadGraph().codeEdges and strips the synthetic containers from graph.nodes; load() rehydrates. ENDPOINT: optional edges[] folded into /overlay/code-nodes/{bulk,replace}; dedicated POST /overlay/code-edges/replace + DELETE /overlay/code-edges. WIRING: ingest.js resolves+sends edges on full onboard (was dropping); sync.js recomputes edges repo-wide on change (changed file's edges resolve vs other files' symbols) → replace per changed file / remove per deleted file, guarded on client edge-op support for back-compat. onboard-code.js surfaces edge counts.

TESTS (all green): test/code-edge-resolve.test.js (21 — name→node, ambiguity, external, import-fan, determinism), test/code-edge-persist.test.js (45 — storage, reload survival, routes, ingest+sync stubbed), extended test/code-sync-e2e.test.js (17 — edges round-trip through a REAL daemon on full onboard + incremental sync). Existing code-sync-unit (53), code-node-bulk (26), code-extract (35), graph-store (119), overlay/search/judge/note suites all pass

subject: Part 1a: persist AST code edges as code_node graph edges
description: The AST extractor (lib/code-extract) already emits call/import edges [{from,to,kind}] but lib/code-extract/ingest.js drops them (only symbols→code_nodes are persisted; ingest.js:37 notes "(later) edge sync" never built). Build the deterministic structural wiring — NO LLM judge (code↔code edges are ground truth): (1) a resolution pass turning raw edges into code_node↔code_node edges — call edges currently carry from=file, to=callee NAME (unresolved, babel.js:50); resolve callee name → defining code_node (handle ambiguity/externals), and map file→file import edges onto code_nodes; (2) overlay storage for code edges + a bulk ingest endpoint (extend routes/overlay.js code-nodes routes); (3) wire ingest.js to persist edges on full onboard and lib/code-extract/sync.js to update them on incremental git-diff sync (add/modify/delete). Add unit tests. Files: lib/code-extract/ingest.js, lib/code-extract/sync.js, lib/code-extract/index.js, lib/overlay.js, lib/graph-store.js, routes/overlay.js, new resolver module.
